title: Secret String Patterns
statement: The task is to decide, using at most 5 interactive queries that each return the number of ones in a range [l, r] of a hidden binary string of length n up to 2·10^4, whether the string contains a 0 immediately followed by a 1. The key observation is that no "01" exists exactly when the string is all ones followed by all zeros, which two prefix-count queries can verify.
